The terrestrial component of CLOCA’s Integrated Monitoring Program is comprised of 24 long-term forest monitoring stations. The purpose of this program is to track forest health over time. All stations are located within mixed and deciduous forest patches and were selected based on even distribution and accessibility. Each station is monitored annually for tree health & downed woody debris, plant community, and breeding birds.
